notes.title: Water and Power added to Metropolis!
notes.content:
In this latest update we have included options to buy and sell units of water and power. Both utilities can be produced, consumed, bought and sold. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31888611/07827e8153f3cff7ab20c1f598f9854bf1559878.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31888611/a3062d1048a0c0f32fa7863f90c869ee131e984c.png[/img]

The price per unit of each utility is influenced by the global economy. So dive in and start producing these utilities to boost your city income, just remember the two things don't mix!

notes.title: Metropolis - The Ultimate City Simulator Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31888611/361f00374305850539c0230235443f83ef81af63.png[/img]

Here at Studio by the Bay we are pleased to announce the upcoming release of 'Metropolis.'

Metropolis is a city simulator like no other. In your role as Mayor you need to rebuild and regenerate your city to become one of the best in the world. Financial mismanagement has brought the city to it's knees and the previous administration are facing many accusations of corruption and embezzlement.

 As the newly elected Mayor your challenge is to rebuild the city to become the top 'most liveable city' in the world. Your task won't be easy, all essential services have been run down and the major buildings of the city have fallen into disrepair. While breathing life back into the city you'll have to watch your back, political opponents are ready to strike at every opportunity and your fate will be decided at the next election.

Metropolis is a game of construction, management, politics and real estate. Manage your city to become 'The World's Most Liveable City.'  Build, sell and manage real estate, set policies, fight crime, buy and sell stocks, change tax rates, set welfare levels, create jobs, battle unemployment and global recession, survive press scrutiny and mayor elections.

Release date set for 29/3/2018
